items.h: Product Type: Three-in-One Fiber Optic Tester
Optical Power Measurement Range: -50 to +26 dBm

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The TFN V10C Three-in-One Fiber Optic Tester is a professional and portable fiber testing tool designed for fiber optic installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and FTTH network applications. It combines an Optical Power Meter OPM, Visual Fault Locator VFL, and LED Light in a single compact device.


The built-in Optical Power Meter supports a measurement range of -50 to +26 dBm, making it suitable for checking optical signal power in fiber optic networks. The integrated 10mW Visual Fault Locator can detect visible fiber faults and breaks over distances of up to 10KM. The built-in LED light provides additional illumination when working inside network cabinets, racks, and other low-light environments.


The TFN V10C is a practical solution for ISP technicians, fiber optic installers, network engineers, and maintenance professionals who need multiple fiber testing functions in one handheld device.


Key Features


  • Three-in-one fiber optic testing device
  • Integrated Optical Power Meter OPM
  • OPM measurement range of -50 to +26 dBm
  • Built-in 10mW Visual Fault Locator VFL
  • VFL testing distance up to 10KM
  • Integrated LED light for dark working environments
  • Portable and convenient handheld design
  • Suitable for fiber installation and maintenance
  • Helps identify fiber breaks and connection problems
  • Ideal for FTTH, FTTx, ISP and telecom network applications
